div.div:
P5 agent action gateway: components
AI agents change Kubernetes only through this gate, which speaks MCP (Model Context Protocol): policy check, dry run, a plain-English risk summary, Slack approval, a narrowly scoped service account, an audit record and undo. The code decides; the LLM only explains. Runs in the session GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) cluster, reached only through kubectl port-forward; nothing is public.

div.div: MCP: Model Context Protocol, how agents call tools. OPA: Open Policy Agent; Rego is its policy language. KSA: Kubernetes service account. RBAC: role-based access control. PDB: PodDisruptionBudget. LLM: large language model. Presidio: open-source detector that masks personal data. CLI: command line. NAT: network address translation. VPC: Virtual Private Cloud. WIF: Workload Identity Federation. Socket Mode: our app opens the connection to Slack, so nothing in the cluster listens for Slack.
